messages:
Sam (partnerships): Heads-up: new marketplace reviewer asked for a gated reviewer flow + a compact SOC2 snapshot + pen-test 'vuln-class' table for the ACME listing. They want artifacts in a manifest CSV. Deadline: end of week.
Eve (security): I can produce the SOC2 one-page snapshot and a vuln-class table (severity, affected component, mitigation status). We'll also create a redaction_map.txt for anything removed.
Liam (cloud): Upload plan: create partners/acme/2187654321/ with artifacts and a manifest.csv that lists filename, size_bytes, checksum_sha256. I'll generate presigned upload endpoints.
Noah (SI): For the pen witness we prefer a 75-min remote slot. We'll run focused tests on auth, cache isolation, and telemetry scrub. Need partner logs 24h before the call.
Aisha (legal): If gated reviewer access will include marketplace employees only, we need a short access attestation and a reviewer agreement. I'll draft a one-paragraph reviewer clause.
Marta (sales): Partner is on a tight PR timeline. They can provide build artifacts today but need confirmed reviewer access before announcing. I'll push them to deliver logs by tomorrow morning.
marketplace-bot: Ingestion tips: include metadata.json with fields partner_name, listing_id, artifact_types, evidence_ts, contact_email, checksum_sha256. If using gated access, include access_policy_url. See https://marketplace.docs/ingest.
Eve (security): Proposed artifacts: soc2-snapshot.pdf, vuln-class.csv, pen-exec-summary.pdf, redaction_map.txt, manifest.csv, metadata.json. I'll mark any high-risk findings in the vuln-class as "requires-gated-detail".
Liam (cloud): For manifest.csv format use: filename,size_bytes,sha256. Example: soc2-snapshot.pdf,24567,3a7f... I will also provide multipart presign instructions for >50MB.
Noah (SI): I'll prepare a 1-page witness runbook with timeline and test vectors. If partner can't provide logs we'll list a scope gap in runbook and proceed with limited tests.
Aisha (legal): Reminder: do not publish firmware hashes or customer identifiers in public artifacts. If redaction removes evidence of a failed control, we must log the reason and provide gated access to the reviewer.
Sam (partnerships): Owners: Eve -> artifacts & redaction_map, Liam -> uploads + manifest + presigns, Noah -> witness runbook & schedule, Aisha -> reviewer agreement, Marta -> partner ops comms. Target: artifacts uploaded (gated) by Thu EOD; presigns posted here.
Marta (sales): Partner confirms logs delivery window: tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll confirm ops lead and paste contact.
Eve (security): ETA for initial redacted bundle and vuln-class table: tomorrow 6pm PT. Will flag entries that need legal review.
Liam (cloud): Once legal OKs the redaction_map, I'll create the gated bucket and presigns. I will include metadata.json and manifest.csv. ETA: Fri AM.
Noah (SI): Tentative witness slots: Tue 10:00-11:15 PT or Wed 13:00-14:15 PT. Marta, tell partner to pick one.
Aisha (legal): Drafting reviewer clause now. Will post draft here for quick sign-off. If reviewer needs NDA, we'll use a short reviewer agreement.
marketplace-bot: Note: uploads over 50MB require multipart presign. CLI example: `aws s3api create-multipart-upload --bucket redwood-evidence --key partners/acme/2187654321/<file>`
Sam (partnerships): Great. Please post manifest.csv and metadata.json in thread (no secrets). Paste presign endpoints here when ready. I'll send a short confirmation note to the marketplace PM once we have presigns. :rocket:
